name: Salvatore Ferragamo S.p.A.
summary: Salvatore Ferragamo S.p.A., through its subsidiaries, creates, produces, and sells luxury goods for men and women in Europe, North America, Japan, the Asia Pacific, and Central and South America. The company offers men's and women's footwear; leather goods comprising handbags, suitcases, belts, wallets, and other men's and women's leather accessories; made-to-order men's and ladies products; ready to wear products for men's and ladies, including knitwear, clothes for formal occasions and outwear, such as husky jackets, ponchos, and leather garments, as well as sportswear, and leisure wear.
